narrative:
## Handover Summary — Workforce & Clinical Staffing

Workforce plan validated against the cost of care and the care-day plan.

## Key Decisions
• Agency target 5% of clinical hours — 180 agency roles converted to permanent
• Retention payment and flexible rostering for physiotherapists in rural clinics
• Standalone finance, HR and IT roles replace the carve-out transitional services

## Recommendation for Consolidation
Stress-test the Paracelsus occupancy ramp against the hiring timeline — the revenue uplift assumes nursing staff are in place by Q2.

signals.title: Carve-out completed — PAI Partners 67%, Fresenius 33%
signals.excerpt: The former Vamed rehabilitation business operates as VITREA, owned 67% by PAI Partners and 33% by Fresenius; standalone functions replace transitional services.
